calls.reason: Dziri et al. show multiplication failing outside fine-tuning splits. But Jelassi et al. find a few priming examples restore generalization, and Gambardella et al. point to other error mechanisms, so the training-outlier cause is not established for general LLMs.

A 2024 test of a simple altered reasoning problem (AIW) found most models far below 20% correct and very sensitive to small variations. Vision OOD benchmarks and the materials study both point the same way: models fail on inputs truly outside their training domain.
This is an open-ended forecast with no listed promises, no threshold for 'many' and no deadline. The packet holds only an AGI framework paper, which cannot settle it.

A perturbation benchmark shows reasoning dropping on altered questions, but the paper admits some changes also made the questions harder. The Waymo recall blames mapping and perception conditions, not an untrained outlier, so neither domain clearly shows the causal link.
